about_the_game:
About This Game

Uncontrolled is a story-driven co-op horror adventure where two players must control each other to survive. Communication is your only weapon in this eerie, mind-bending world where nothing is as it seems.

Trapped in a mysterious facility full of puzzles, traps, and dark secrets, you'll need to coordinate every step — but here's the twist: you can't control yourself. Your partner controls your actions, and you control theirs. Trust becomes your greatest challenge.

Will you overcome fear, confusion, and your partner’s questionable decisions to escape together? Or will chaos take control?

Key Features:

  •  Unique "You control your friend" co-op gameplay

  •  Challenging puzzles that demand real teamwork

  •  A tense atmosphere with psychological horror elements

  •  Built entirely around voice communication and trust

  •  Multiple chapters with immersive environments and evolving mechanics

Uncontrolled is not just a game — it’s a test of connection, coordination, and your ability to let go of control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600, 3.3 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Uncontrolled is a co-op horror adventure where you control your friend, not yourself. Solve puzzles, survive traps, and escape a twisted facility using only voice and trust. Can you work together when control isn’t in your hands?
